create_DiagonalGaussianDistribution_samp: create a DiagonalGaussianDistribution from parameters tensor and sample from it using the sample method
create_DiagonalGaussianDistribution_kl: create a DiagonalGaussianDistribution and compute its KL divergence against a standard normal or another distribution
create_DiagonalGaussianDistribution_nll: create a DiagonalGaussianDistribution and compute the negative log likelihood of a sample
create_DiracDistribution_sample: create a DiracDistribution with a fixed value and retrieve samples or the mode
run_normal_kl: run normal_kl to compute the KL divergence between two Gaussian distributions given their means and log variances
